info.desc: Wild Honey is the 13th studio album by The Beach Boys, released on December 18, 1967. It was the group's first foray into soul music. The album's sessions began immediately after the recording of Lei'd in Hawaii, a failed live album, and the release of Smiley Smile, their previous LP. Like Smiley Smile, Wild Honey's core instrumental combo consists of organ, honky-tonk piano, and electric bass. The Beach Boys were inspired to regroup as a self-contained rock band, partly in response to critical assertions that they were "ball-less choir boys".They also purposely distanced themselves from the prevailing rock trends of .

podcast.body: Released in July 1967, this album went almost unnoticed, especially when compared to The Beatles' monumental Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band. The lukewarm reception led to The Beach Boys being perceived as a conservative band, and Brian Wilson significantly reduced his compositional role, retreating further into reclusion. "Por el contrario, el siguiente disco de los Beach Boys, Wild Honey, pasó casi desapercibido y la banda comenzó a ser vista como conservadora."
